orders.description: Help with your orders and deliveries
orders.place_order: How do I place an order?

place_order.question: How do I place an order on Asso?
place_order.answer: To place an order, browse the available products, add them to your cart by tapping "Add to cart", then open your cart and follow the payment steps. You will receive an email confirmation once the order is confirmed.

track_order.question: How do I track my order?
track_order.answer: You can track your order in real time from the "My Orders" section of your profile. You will also receive notifications at each delivery step (preparation, shipping, on the way, delivered).

cancel_order.question: Can I cancel my order?
cancel_order.answer: Yes, you can cancel an order as long as it has not been shipped. Go to "My Orders", select the order and tap "Cancel". The refund will be processed within 5 to 7 business days.

damaged_product.question: What if I receive a damaged product?
damaged_product.answer: Contact our customer service immediately through the app with photos of the damaged product. We will arrange a free return and a replacement or refund, as you prefer.

payment_methods.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
payment_methods.answer: We accept Mobile Money (MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money), cash on delivery and bank transfers. All online payments are secure and encrypted.

payment_security.question: Is online payment secure?
payment_security.answer: Absolutely. We use SSL encryption to protect your payment information. Your banking details are never stored on our servers and are sent directly to certified payment providers.

cash_on_delivery.question: How does cash on delivery work?
cash_on_delivery.answer: Select "Cash on delivery" at checkout. You will pay the courier in cash when you receive your order. This option may require additional verification.

refund_time.question: How long does a refund take?
refund_time.answer: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after your request is approved. The time may vary depending on your original payment method.

create_account.question: How do I create an account?
create_account.answer: Tap "Sign up" on the home screen, enter your details (name, email, phone) and create a password. You will receive a verification code by SMS to activate your account.

forgot_password.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
forgot_password.answer: Tap "Forgot password" on the login screen. Enter your email or phone number and follow the instructions to reset your password.

edit_info.question: How do I edit my personal information?
edit_info.answer: Go to your profile, tap "Edit profile" and update your information (name, email, phone, address). Don't forget to save your changes.

delete_account.question: Can I delete my account?
delete_account.answer: Yes, you can delete your account from the settings. Warning: this action cannot be undone and all your data will be permanently deleted.

delivery_zones.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
delivery_zones.answer: We deliver to all major cities in Cameroon: Douala, Yaoundé, Bafoussam, Bamenda, Garoua, Maroua, Ngaoundéré and many more. Delivery times may vary depending on your location.

delivery_fees.question: What are the delivery fees?
delivery_fees.answer: Delivery fees vary depending on your area and the weight of your order. They are calculated automatically at checkout. Delivery is free for orders over 50,000 FCFA in some areas.

delivery_time.question: How long does delivery take?
delivery_time.answer: Standard delivery takes 24-48 hours for Douala and Yaoundé, and 3-5 days for other cities. You will be told the exact time when you place your order.

change_address.question: Can I change the delivery address?
change_address.answer: Yes, you can change the delivery address before your order is shipped. Contact our customer service as soon as possible to make the change.

become_vendor.question: How do I become a vendor on Asso?
become_vendor.answer: Go to the "Become a Vendor" section in your profile. Fill in the form with your business information, upload the required documents, and our team will review your application within 48-72 hours.

vendor_fees.question: What are the fees for selling on Asso?
vendor_fees.answer: We offer several plans: Free (15% commission), Basic (5000 FCFA/month, 10% commission), Pro (15000 FCFA/month, 5% commission). Choose the plan that suits your sales volume.

add_product.question: How do I add a product for sale?
add_product.answer: In your vendor dashboard, tap "Add a product", fill in the details (title, description, price, photos, category) and publish. Your products will be visible once approved.

manage_stock.question: How do I manage my stock?
manage_stock.answer: Use the "Stock management" section of your dashboard to track your inventory in real time, get low-stock alerts and update available quantities.

what_is_asso.question: What is Asso?
what_is_asso.answer: Asso is a Cameroonian marketplace connecting vendors and buyers. We make it easy to buy and sell a wide range of products (fashion, electronics, home, food) with secure payment and reliable delivery.

contact_support.question: How do I contact customer service?
contact_support.answer: You can reach us by email (support@asso-corporation.com), phone (658895572 / 651826475) or WhatsApp. Our team is available 24/7 to assist you.

app_free.question: Is the app free?
app_free.answer: Yes, the Asso app is completely free to download and use for buyers. Vendors can choose between a free account with commission or paid plans.

report_issue.question: How do I report a problem or a fraudulent product?
report_issue.answer: Use the "Report" button on the product page or contact our customer service directly. We take the safety of our community very seriously and will investigate promptly.

help.title: Help & Support
help.team_available: Our team is available to help you 24/7

place_order.question: How do I place an order?
place_order.answer: To place an order, browse our product catalog, add the items you want to your cart, then tap "Order". Enter your delivery details and choose your payment method to complete the order.

track_order.question: How do I track my order?
track_order.answer: You can track your order by going to "My orders" from the main menu. Tap the order you want to track to see its status in real time and the courier's location.

cancel_order.question: Can I cancel my order?
cancel_order.answer: Yes, you can cancel your order as long as it is not out for delivery. Go to "My orders", select the order and tap "Cancel". A refund will be issued if the payment has already been processed.

delivery_times.question: What are the delivery times?
delivery_times.answer:
Delivery times vary depending on your location:
• Urban area: 1-2 hours
• Suburban area: 2-4 hours
• Rural area: 24-48 hours

payment_methods.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment_methods.answer:
We accept several payment methods:
• Mobile payment (Mobile Money, Orange Money)
• Bank card (Visa, Mastercard)
• Cash on delivery
• Bank transfer

payment_security.question: Is my payment information secure?
payment_security.answer: Yes, all transactions are secured with SSL encryption. We do not store your card details on our servers. All payments are processed by PCI-DSS certified payment gateways.

get_refund.question: How do I get a refund?
get_refund.answer: To request a refund, contact our customer service with your order number. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days and credited to the original payment method.

create_account.question: How do I create an account?
create_account.answer: Tap "Sign up" on the home page, fill in your details (name, email, phone, password), then verify your account with the code sent by SMS or email.

forgot_password.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
forgot_password.answer: Tap "Forgot password" on the login page, enter your email or phone number and follow the instructions to reset your password.

edit_info.question: How do I edit my personal information?
edit_info.answer: Go to "Settings" > "Edit profile" from the menu. There you can change your name, photo, phone number, delivery address, etc.

delete_account.question: How do I delete my account?
delete_account.answer: To delete your account, go to "Settings" > "Data and privacy" > "Delete my account". This action cannot be undone and all your data will be deleted.

return_product.question: Can I return a product?
return_product.answer: Yes, you have 7 days from receipt to return an unused product in its original packaging. Contact customer service to start a return.

damaged_product.question: What if I receive a damaged product?
damaged_product.answer: If you receive a damaged product, refuse the delivery and contact our customer service immediately with photos. We will arrange a replacement or a refund.

refund_time.question: How long does a refund take?
refund_time.answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the return is received and approved. The amount will be credited to your original payment method.
